introHtml: Cameonoveltypencorp supplies a range of markers perfect for custom imprinting, from highlighters to specialty Sharpie® options. Whether you need bright rPET highlighters for office giveaways or metallic markers for premium event kits, these markers offer reliable performance and a large imprint area for your logo. Durable, practical, and easy to distribute, they make effective promotional tools for trade shows, back-to-school campaigns, or corporate branding efforts.
